description:
Situated in a peaceful cul-de-sac location, this spacious detached family home offers a comfortable living experience. The property features a welcoming living room and dining room, perfect for entertaining guests. The kitchen breakfast room and utility room provide practicality and convenience for daily living.

With four generously sized bedrooms, including a master bedroom with an en-suite shower room, there is ample space for the whole family to enjoy. Outside, the property boasts gardens to the front and rear, providing a perfect outdoor retreat.

Additional benefits include a garage, driveway, and easy access to local amenities such as shops, supermarkets, sports facilities, and parks. The property is located in a popular residential area on the southern rural fringe of the city, with excellent access to schools, public transport links, and major road networks. Don't miss out on the opportunity to call this charming property your new home. Contact us today to arrange a viewing.

Directions Head south on London Road, taking the left onto Cumwhinton Road, at the mini roundabout take the first exit. Left on to Hunters Crescent and left again onto Watermans Walk. Then left onto Longmans Close.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
